title: Tomato Garlic Pasta
description: A simple pasta with a quick tomato and garlic sauce.
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to its package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of cooking water before draining.
Chop the tomatoes and mince the garlic. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Toss in the pasta and enough reserved water to loosen the sauce. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Pasta
description: Pasta and broccoli in a light cheddar sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta following package directions. Add the broccoli for the final 4 minutes, then drain.
In the empty pot, warm the butter and milk over low heat.
Stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until melted. Do not boil.
Fold in the pasta, broccoli and salt and serve immediately.

title: Spinach Mushroom Omelet
description: Two folded omelets filled with tender vegetables.
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt in a bowl.
Heat half the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook the mushrooms for 5 minutes, then wilt the spinach for 1 minute. Transfer to a plate.
Add half the remaining oil and half the eggs. Cook gently until set with no runny egg remaining.
Add half the vegetables, fold the omelet and transfer to a plate. Repeat with the remaining oil, eggs and vegetables.

title: Avocado Egg Toast
description: Crisp toast with mashed avocado and fully cooked eggs.
steps: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with the salt.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and cook until both whites and yolks are firm, flipping if needed.
Spread the avocado on the toast and top each slice with an egg.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Small banana pancakes made with oats and eggs.
steps: Blend the oats to a coarse flour. Add the banana, eggs and milk and blend into a batter. Rest for 5 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Cook small pancakes for 2–3 minutes per side, using the remaining butter as needed, until the centers are set and no wet batter remains.

title: Berry Yogurt Bowls
description: Creamy yogurt topped with berries and oats.
steps: Wash, hull and slice the strawberries.
Divide the yogurt between two bowls.
Top with the strawberries and oats and drizzle with honey.

title: Chicken and Broccoli Rice
description: A skillet chicken and broccoli topping for rice.
steps: Cook the rice with water according to its package directions.
On a separate cutting board, cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Wash hands and clean surfaces after handling raw chicken. Mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 6–8 minutes, turning often.
Add the broccoli, garlic and 1/4 cup water. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the broccoli is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) in its thickest pieces.
Stir in the soy sauce and serve over rice.

title: Lemon Salmon and Potatoes
description: Roasted salmon with crisp-edged potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Cut the potatoes into small 2 cm pieces.
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and salt on a baking tray. Roast for 20 minutes.
Move the potatoes aside and add the salmon. Brush it with the remaining oil and season with the remaining salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Roast for another 12–15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the salmon reaches 145°F (63°C) in its thickest part.

title: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Golden tofu with broccoli and bell pepper.
steps: Drain and pat the tofu dry, then cube it. Slice the bell pepper and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning to brown several sides. Transfer to a plate.
Add the broccoli, bell pepper and 3 tablespoons water. Cover and cook for 4 minutes.
Uncover and add the garlic, tofu and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 2 minutes and serve hot.

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas filled with black beans and melted cheese.
steps: Drain and rinse the beans and lightly mash them. Dice the tomato.
Divide the beans, cheese and tomato over half of each tortilla and fold closed.
Heat a little oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the quesadillas in batches for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and hot throughout, with melted cheese.

title: Chickpea Cucumber Salad
description: A crunchy bean salad with a lemon dressing.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Wash and dice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil and salt in a bowl.
Add the chickpeas and vegetables and toss thoroughly. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Tuna Cucumber Wraps
description: Quick tuna wraps with cucumber and yogurt.
steps: Drain the canned tuna and mix it with the yogurt, lemon juice and black pepper.
Slice the cucumber into thin strips.
Divide the tuna mixture and cucumber between the tortillas, fold in the ends and roll tightly.

title: Roasted Vegetable Tray
description: A colorful tray of potatoes, carrots and zucchini.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Cut the potatoes and carrots into small pieces and the zucchini into thick half-moons.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with the oil, salt and pepper on a baking tray. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini, stir and roast for another 15 minutes, until all vegetables are tender and golden.

title: Tomato Lentil Soup
description: A hearty red lentil soup with carrots and tomatoes.
steps: Rinse the lentils. Finely chop the onion, carrot, tomatoes and garlic.
Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, salt and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils and carrots are tender. Add more water if needed.

title: Apple Yogurt Cups
description: Crisp apple and creamy yogurt with a little cinnamon.
steps: Wash, core and dice the apple.
Divide the yogurt and apple between two bowls.
Sprinkle with cinnamon, drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Garlic Green Beans
description: Tender green beans tossed with garlic and lemon.
steps: Trim and wash the green beans. Mince the garlic.
Simmer the beans in water for 4–6 minutes until tender, then drain.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the beans, salt and lemon juice and toss for 1 minute.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Pasta with an egg-and-cheese sauce and crisp cured pork.

title: Greek Salad
description: Tomatoes, cucumber, feta and olives with a vinegar dressing.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Chicken, peppers and onions served with tortillas and avocado.

title: Egg Fried Rice
description: A wok-style rice dish with eggs, vegetables and savory sauces.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
description: Chicken thighs with a soy, mirin and sake marinade.
timeNote: Active time only; allow additional marinating time.

title: Cheeseburgers
description: Beef burgers with cheese, lettuce, tomato and pickles.
timeNote: Single-patty version; choose sauces on the original page.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken in a spiced tomato and cream sauce.
timeNote: Plus 3–24 hours of marinating; serves 4–5. Rice is an optional accompaniment.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh mozzarella and small tomatoes with herbs and a tangy dressing.

title: French Toast
description: Pan-fried egg-soaked bread for breakfast. See the source for optional fruit and syrup.

title: Lemon Hummus
description: A creamy chickpea dip with tahini and lemon.
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Peel the garlic and juice the lemon.
Blend the chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Blend in cold water a tablespoon at a time until smooth. Divide between two bowls.

title: Tomato Bruschetta
description: Crunchy toast topped with tomatoes and basil.
steps: Dice the tomatoes and finely slice the basil. Toss them with the oil and salt.
Toast the bread until crisp. Halve the garlic and rub its cut side lightly over the toast.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toast and serve immediately.

title: Sesame Cucumber Noodles
description: Cool noodles with cucumber and a sesame dressing.
steps: Cook the noodles following their package instructions. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the tahini, soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil with 2 tablespoons water. Thin with more water if needed.
Cut the cucumber into narrow strips and toss with the noodles and dressing.

title: Black Bean Rice Bowls
description: Rice bowls with beans, corn and avocado.
steps: Cook the rice in water according to the package instructions.
Rinse the beans, then heat with corn, cumin, salt and 3 tablespoons water in a saucepan until steaming hot throughout.
Slice the avocado. Divide the rice and bean mixture between two bowls and add avocado and lime juice.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Chicken with peanuts, chilies and a tangy Sichuan-style sauce.
timeNote: Allow 10–20 minutes to marinate; rice is an optional accompaniment.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
description: Stir-fried chicken noodles with cabbage, carrots and bean sprouts.
timeNote: Serves 2–3; check the source for marinating and noodle preparation.

title: Butter Chicken
description: Marinated chicken in a creamy tomato curry.
timeNote: Plus at least 3 hours marinating; serves 3–4. Rice and garnishes are optional.

title: Dal (Indian Lentil Curry)
description: Yellow lentils simmered with aromatics and Indian spices.
timeNote: Plus 1 hour soaking; serves 3–4. See source for optional chili, tadka and rice; mustard is in the optional tadka.

title: Cheese Pizza
description: A simple cheese pizza with a crisp crust, tomato sauce and melted mozzarella. Uses prepared pizza dough.
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F (245°C), or the temperature specified on your dough package. Lightly oil a baking tray.
Stretch the prepared dough into a roughly 12-inch circle on the tray. If it springs back, let it rest for 5 minutes before stretching again.
Spread the pizza sauce over the dough, leaving a small border. Sprinkle the mozzarella evenly over the sauce.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, or according to the dough package, until the crust is golden, the center is cooked through and the cheese is bubbling.
Let the pizza rest for 3 minutes, then slice and serve.

title: Roma Tomato & Basil Cheese Pizza
description: Refrigerated pizza dough topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, Parmesan, garlic, Roma tomatoes and fresh basil.
steps: Prepare the refrigerated dough according to its package instructions, allowing it to rest if required. Heat the oven to the package temperature; for dough without instructions, use 475°F (245°C).
Pat the sliced Roma tomatoes dry. Lightly grease a baking tray with half the olive oil and stretch the dough into a roughly 12-inch circle on the tray.
Mix the pizza sauce with the minced garlic and Italian seasoning. Spread over the dough, leaving a small border.
Sprinkle on the mozzarella, arrange the tomato slices on top and finish with the grated Parmesan. Brush the exposed crust with the remaining olive oil.
Bake according to the dough package, or for approximately 12–15 minutes at 475°F (245°C), until the crust is golden, the center is baked through and the cheese is bubbling.
Tear the fresh basil over the baked pizza. Rest for 3 minutes, then slice and serve.
timeNote: Allow extra resting time if required by the dough package. For a vegetarian pizza, choose mozzarella and Parmesan made with vegetarian rennet.
